topic: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Healthcare: Architectures, Communication Efficiency, and Clinical Deployment

per_sentence.text: This approach not only preserves data privacy but also allows leveraging diverse datasets from different institutions (Serrano et al., 2026).
